versions.changelog:
Collaboration Manager Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a multi-agent collaboration manager with dynamic @ mention handling, task assignment, and smart response rules.
- Implements strict "@优先" (mention-priority) group chat logic; agents only respond when mentioned or relevant, avoiding message flooding.
- Defines clear agent roles (Juna, Code Master, CEVA, System Engineer, 102 Housekeeper) with keyword-based message routing.
- Supports structured workflows for collaboration, parallel/serial task division, task tracking, and progress reporting.
- Provides admin controls to pause, resume, or mute agents in real time.
- Includes detailed message formats and Feishu (Lark) card templates for collaborative tasks and progress updates.
- Features troubleshooting guidance and setup/configuration instructions for group chat integration.
